newsitem.title: USA: Johnson defeats incumbent South Dakota senator.
newsitem.headline: Johnson defeats incumbent South Dakota senator.

text.p: Democratic Representative Tim Johnson defeated third-term incumbent Republican Sen. Larry Pressler in one of the hardest-fought races in the nation on Tuesday, the CNN television network reported.

Pressler, chairman of the Senate Commerce Committee, was a key player in shaping a new telecommunications law during the last session of Congress. But he was also accused of using his chairmanship to raise a huge amount of money from political action committees.
